title: ID0454632-DC/Si-D/FR-[Y2 / R9 313202799057] Terminal Issue
description:
Reported Behavior/Issue: Terminal Issue
Solution:
Following the error you mentioned, and after our analysis, we can confirm that one of the doors is open. If that’s not the case after your checks, then there are three things you need to verify:
Check the 24V emergency line – identify where the voltage is dropping.
Check the door sensor F08-BG4/F03-BG3 – ensure it is working correctly.
Check the F02-XD9/F03-XD9– make sure it is securely connected.
